description: Source code for an OpenAPI Toolkit class implementing INode interface, providing methods to load and process OpenAPI specifications, generate tools for API endpoints, and handle related operations.

classes.name: OpenAPIToolkit_Tools
classes.description: Implements INode; provides methods to initialize, load OpenAPI specs, list servers/endpoints, and generate API tools.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the toolkit, loads OpenAPI spec, processes data, and generates tools based on selected endpoints.

methods.name: loadMethods
methods.description: Contains methods to list available servers and endpoints from the OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: loadOpenApiSpec
methods.description: Loads OpenAPI specification from URL or file, auto-detects format, and returns parsed data.
